name: delete-line-session
details:
Implement delete_line parameter for delete command. Feature 3 of 4 from public-release-beta-v2 plan.

Scope: Targeted single-line deletion capability as alternative to read/remove/write pattern.

tasks.name: Update DeleteCommand interface
tasks.details: Add optional delete_line parameter to DeleteCommand interface in operations.ts (line 50-52)

tasks.name: Update DeleteCommandSchema
tasks.details: Add optional delete_line parameter to Zod schema in mcp-server.ts (line 97-99) with proper description

tasks.name: Implement line deletion logic
tasks.details:
Modify deleteOp function in operations.ts (416-467) to:
- Check if delete_line parameter is provided
- If yes: validate file exists, is file not directory, read content, validate line number (1-based), delete line, write back
- If no: existing file/directory deletion behavior
- Use same validation pattern as insert function (lines.length bounds checking)

tasks.name: Add comprehensive tests
tasks.details:
Add tests to memory-operations.test.ts:
- Delete single line from middle of file
- Delete first line
- Delete last line
- Delete from single-line file (results in empty file)
- Error: line number out of range (too high)
- Error: line number < 1
- Error: delete_line on directory (should fail)
- Error: delete_line on non-existent file

tasks.name: Run full test suite
tasks.details: Verify all tests pass (should be 100+ tests after adding ~8 new tests)

tasks.name: Manual testing with MCP-Debug
tasks.details:
Test both tool modes:
- Unified tool: memory(command: 'delete', path: '/memories/test.txt', delete_line: 2)
- Individual tool: memory_delete(path: '/memories/test.txt', delete_line: 2)
Verify correct line deletion in both modes

tasks.name: Update plan progress
tasks.details: Mark delete_line feature complete in public-release-beta-v2 plan (will be 75% complete, 3 of 4 features done)
